# gtavi-hub-site

Rendered companion site for **GTA VI Hub** — an unofficial Grand Theft Auto VI fan
community. Live at https://jwilksbooth.github.io/gtavi-hub-site once Pages is enabled
(Settings → Pages → Source: **GitHub Actions**).

**Do not edit HTML here.** Everything in this repo is generated output from the private
`gtavi-hub-bot` repo (`site/generate.py`, templates in `site/templates/`, prose in
`site/content/`). Edit there, re-render, push.

No secrets live in this repo, ever (enforced by a post-render scan in the generator and
a pre-commit scrub gate in the bot repo).

*Unofficial fan community — not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.*
